about: Crafty Shield stops every status move aimed at a Pokemon on its side, protect flag or not, and not one aimed at the whole field (Pokemon Central, Truccodifesa: not Perish Song; Showdown's gen-9 craftyshield). Before, it let through the status moves whose records have no protect flag -- Mean Look, Roar, Whirlwind, Transform, Block, Psych Up, Role Play, Sketch, Play Nice. A level-10 Pikachu is given Crafty Shield and Splash in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Mean Look, then only Perish Song. The shield turns the Mean Look away, and the Pikachu stays free; the next turn the Perish Song goes past it. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.

lines: The wild Chansey used Mean Look!
